pairs.gold_text: Deaths were reported in connection with the Aldan House collapse by November 8.
pairs.system_text: Deaths were caused by the collapse of the east wing at Aldan House.

pairs.gold_text: Injuries were confirmed and documented in Nerridge during the collapse response.
pairs.system_text: Injuries were documented in Nerridge in the hours after the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge fire service reported rescuing people during the initial response to the Aldan House collapse.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge fire service rescued people from the collapsed building on the first morning.

pairs.gold_text: PUSAR reported rescuing people on November 4 and again on November 6.
pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue teams rescued people from the rubble of Aldan House.

unmatched_system.text: The west wing of Aldan House did not collapse.
The tower crane at the site did not fall.

pairs.gold_text: The collapse destroyed Aldan House and its east wing.
pairs.system_text: Aldan House and its east wing were destroyed in the collapse on Cobbett Row.

unmatched_gold.text: Later safety updates stated that the west wing had not collapsed.
The tower crane at the site was reported not to have fallen.

pairs.gold_text: Later updates reported restoration of Aldan House.
pairs.system_text: Aldan House and the tower crane were restored at the end of the operational window.

pairs.gold_text: Service at Aldan House was disrupted; later, services were reported closed along Imber Street and Cobbett Row.
pairs.system_text: Services were closed in Imber Street and Cobbett Row.

unmatched_system.text: Service at the Aldan House block was disrupted after the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Dangerous conditions were reported at Cobbett Row while local services remained closed.
pairs.system_text: Dangerous conditions were present at Cobbett Row after the collapse.

unmatched_gold.text: Assistance was provided in Cobbett Row during the later response.

pairs.system_text: Provincial Urban Search and Rescue deployed to Aldan House within two hours of the collapse.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge Police deployed in the city during the later phase of the response.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge Police deployed to Cobbett Row.

pairs.gold_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided information about the east wing during the response.
pairs.system_text: Nerridge Emergency Management provided information about the collapsed east wing.

unmatched_gold.text: Nerridge Police reported that no looting had been reported during the later response.

pairs.gold_text: Requests for assistance were reported during the early phase of the emergency.
pairs.system_text: Assistance was requested in the street outside Aldan House.

pairs.gold_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row during the initial response to the collapse.
pairs.system_text: A warning was issued for Cobbett Row after the collapse.
